canonical_definition: Based on the available data, SAR is characterized as a method for uncertainty estimation. The single provided source defines its mechanism as a combination of entropy with a relevance weighting scheme. This process operates by "amplifying the contribution of semantically important tokens" (Will It Still Be True Tomorrow? Multilingual Evergreen Question Classification to Improve Trustworthy QA). The final value is calculated by summing these adjusted entropy values over the entire sequence. The provided information positions SAR as a technique for estimating uncertainty, though no specific constructs or behaviors it is used to measure are detailed in the supplied relationships.
